recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-45630 unless CQI separately decides to address operation-level terminology such as measure-report-evaluation-type.
issue_request: FHIR-45630 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI technical correction asking that draft code systems and value sets used by Measure and MeasureReport, including measure scoring and measure population, be corrected; the final resolution was to ensure affected profiles reference THO value sets rather than build-local FHIR value sets.
initial_application: Upstream commit 54cef55bb369e0dd5fc4266fad08b4df6d30f37b, merged through HL7/fhir#3423, retargeted Measure and MeasureReport bindings for measure-type, measure-scoring, composite-measure-scoring, measure-improvement-notation, measure-population, measure-aggregate-method, and measure-data-usage to terminology.hl7.org value sets and deleted the corresponding draft local Measure value set definitions. The combined branch already contained that source application but had no prior AutoFHIR Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-45630.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Some local Measure/MeasureReport example value sets remain in core, but they are active and are not the THO-owned value sets identified by the issue. The only remaining draft local measure value set found, measure-report-evaluation-type, is bound by Measure operation definitions rather than by the Measure or MeasureReport resource definitions cited in the Jira comments, so it is outside this seed's applied scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch already binds Measure.group.population.code, MeasureReport.group.population.code, and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.population.code to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/measure-population, and the other affected Measure/MeasureReport bindings from the upstream application also point to THO.
